lines.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth;
break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre,
in melodious song with the harp.
With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn
shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
Let the sea resound, and all that fills it,
the world, and all who dwell in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands,
let the mountains sing together for joy
for He comes to judge the earth.
He will judge the world with righteousness

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — the oldest king kneeling with his hands joined and his crown set down on the broken stones, all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_heil

pictures.scene: Orazio Gentileschi, Saint Cecilia and an Angel — Cecilia at the keyboard with the angel beside her holding the music, sing praises to the LORD with the lyre
pictures.name: pd_gentileschi_lier

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Peasant Dance — the piper with his cheeks full blowing while the whole village breaks out dancing, with trumpets and the blast of the ram's horn
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_bazuin

pictures.scene: Ludolf Bakhuizen, Ships in Distress off a Rocky Coast — the great wave breaking white over the rocks under the storm sky, let the sea resound and all that fills it
pictures.name: pd_bakhuizen_zee

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, El Rio de Luz — the wide river running out of the forest with the sun laid along the water, let the rivers clap their hands
pictures.name: pd_church_rivieren

pictures.scene: Thomas Moran, Mountain of the Holy Cross — the snow lying in a cross on the high peak above the falling water, let the mountains sing together for joy before the LORD
pictures.name: pd_moran_bergen

pictures.scene: Viktor Vasnetsov, The Last Judgment — Christ enthroned with the open book while the angel below holds up the scales, for He comes to judge the world with righteousness
pictures.name: pd_vasnetsov_oordeel

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, the Ghent Altarpiece: The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — the peoples of every nation kneeling in the meadow around the Lamb and the fountain, and the peoples with equity
pictures.name: pd_eyck_volkeren
